messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [ALERT] function-invoker service high error rate and queue depth spike detected. 5xxs -> 18% across frontend->invoker, p95 latency > 3s, queue depth 18k, autoscaler not catching up. Started 08:33 PDT. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/invoke-overload. Please ack and follow oncall playbook.

alex: ack. I'm jumping into logs, can someone check if this correlates with the structured-output agent rollout? saw a bump around 08:30.

jordan: looking at infra metrics — GPU pool for invoker is healthy but downstream KV cache is saturated. There's a flood of external function/toolcall requests from a small set of tenants. I can throttle at the edge.

maria: we should avoid a full shutdown. proposal: softblock tool/function calling for free and dev tiers, keep enterprise on. Also disable structured output streaming (json streaming) globally for a short window to reduce long-lived streams.

sara: agreed. customer impact expected: prompt-based toolchain features will return a 429 or a synthetic response quickly for affected tiers. We'll mark it as "degraded: tool invocation disabled" in status. Need copy for support.

oncall-shiftbot: @alex assigned incident-owner. Please coordinate mitigations and update this thread when gates are live.

alex: implementing staged policy now. Step 1: deploy edge rate-limit rule to block 'tool-invoke' header for plans [free, dev, basic]. Step 2: flip feature-flag disable_structured_json_streaming=true. Pushing changes in 2m. Posting config snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.prod/internal/traffic-shaper/v1/policies \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OPKEY" \
  -d '{"policy":"softblock_toolcall","target_plans":["free","dev","basic"],"response_code":429,"reason":"temporary tool invocation softblock"}'
```

jordan: I'm also enabling a 10rps-per-tenant cap on toolcalls at the L4 LB as backup. Applying now.

maria: monitoring dashboards show queue depth dropping after the L4 cap applied. nice. p50 latency improving. Keep the structured streaming disabled for 15min and re-evaluate.

sara: drafting status page and support blurb: "We are temporarily restricting function/tool calling and streaming structured outputs for lower-tier customers to stabilize platform performance. Enterprise customers unaffected. We expect full restoration within 2 hours. We're proactively notifying customers with active tool usage." I'll paste drafts here for approval.

support-team: paste draft please, we'll send via Intercom to affected customers. need a clear CTA for customers to reach support if they see degraded behavior.

alex: status copy posted to status.redwood.ai: "Degraded: Function/tool invocation limited for select plans to mitigate overload. Working on rollback and capacity scaling." I also added a targeted alert for tenants with >1000 toolcalls/min so we can reach out.

jordan: infra note — autoscaler failed due to excessive ephemeral connections from streaming toolcalls. We've adjusted LB keepalive and raised backend connection limit temporarily. That plus L4 cap reduced new inflight work.

maria: quick checklist for mitigation owner (alex): 1) confirm edge policy applied (done), 2) disable structured streaming flag (done), 3) start tenant outreach for top 10 noisy tenants (sara/support), 4) monitor error budget and queue depth every 5m, 5) prepare rollback plan (scale GPU pool or widen cap).

sara: I've started tenant outreach for top 3 noisy tenants — they've been informed and asked to backoff. Two replied, one is investigating a runaway agent job. Support will open high-priority tickets.

alex: next steps: hold these mitigations for 15 minutes and reassess. If recovery trend holds, we'll gradually relax plan restrictions: first re-enable dev, then free. Maria, set a baseline metric target: queue depth < 4k and 5xx < 2% for 10m before changes.

maria: baseline set and alarm created.

oncall-shiftbot: Handoff note: @alex you own until 09:30 PDT then handoff to @jordan. Please ensure handoff checklist in this thread.

alex: acknowledged. leaving a runbook pointer in the thread and will summarize state at HTO.

jordan: taking over at 09:30. If we see regression after re-enable, we'll pivot to per-tenant throttles and consider a short maintenance window to add capacity.

sara: support comms sent to affected customers and status page updated with time stamps. Will append updates as we progress.

maria: current metrics at 08:50 PDT: queue depth 3.8k, 5xx 1.7%, p95 latency 1.4s. Looks stable. Recommend staged rollback in 10m.

alex: rollback plan executed at 09:05: re-enable structured streaming for internal-only tenants, keep softblock on free/dev for +30m. Monitoring closely.

support-team: customers notified of partial restoration. We'll escalate any reports.

oncall-shiftbot: Incident update: mitigations applied, partial restore in progress. Keep channel updated.

alex: handoff to @jordan at 09:30 PDT. Summary: edge softblock applied for free/dev/basic, structured JSON streaming disabled briefly, L4 per-tenant cap enforced, queue depth reduced. Next: monitor for 1h, prepare capacity scale if noisy tenants don't throttle.

jordan: @alex thanks, taking it. I'll keep this thread as the control log.

----- END THREAD -----
